pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Heidenfeld Variation
pages.notes: Plan 4 had Black's plan name White's Nb5 as a move. Reworded plan 4; British spelling in plan 1.

pages.name: Sicilian: Kan, 5.c4 Nf6 6.Nc3 Bb4
pages.notes: Plan 3 named White's f3 as a Black move. Reworded plan 3 in words.

pages.name: Sicilian: Taimanov, 6.g3 a6 7.Bg2 Nf6 8.O-O Bc5
pages.notes: Plan 2 named White's Nb3 as a Black move. Reworded plan 2; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Moscow 3...Nc6 4.O-O Bd7 5.Re1 Nf6 6.c3 a6 7.Bf1 Bg4 8.h3
pages.notes: Plan 2 met d4 with ...exd4 (no e5-pawn) and claimed ...Bxf3 damages White's structure (Qxf3 recaptures); the overview said ...Bg4 forced h3. Rewrote both plans and the overview's middle sentence; British spelling.

pages.name: Sicilian: Moscow 3...Nd7
pages.notes: Plan 4 rerouted the d7-knight via f8 (bishop there); plan 2 promised a queen trade after Bxd7+; plan 1 had ...b5 with the bishop on b5. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Sicilian: Moscow 3...Nd7 4.O-O
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a Bxc6 trade with no c6-piece and White using the bishop pair after giving it up; plan 2 had ...b5 with the bishop on b5; plan 3 was a vague Nf3-d2 manoeuvre. Rewrote plans 1-3; British spelling.

pages.name: Sicilian: Moscow 3...Nd7 4.O-O Nf6
pages.notes: Plan 3 claimed Bxd7 inflicts a pawn weakness (no pawn recaptures); plan 2 had ...b5 with the bishop on b5; plan 4 was generic. Rewrote plans 2-4; British spelling.

pages.name: Sicilian: Moscow 3...Nd7 4.c3
pages.notes: Plan 4 had ...b5 with the bishop on b5; plan 2's ...Nf6 was ambiguous. Rewrote plans 2 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Sicilian: Moscow 3...Nd7 4.d4 Nf6
pages.notes: Plan 1 recaptured on d4 with the knight; the main line is 6.Qxd4 with Bxd7+, Bg5 and O-O-O. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Sicilian: Moscow 3...Nd7 4.d4 Nf6 5.Nc3 cxd4
pages.notes: Plan 1 had f2-f4 instead of Bxd7+, Bg5 and O-O-O; plan 2 had ...b5-b4 with the bishop on b5; plan 3 played Bxc6+ with the knight on d7. Rewrote plans 1-3; British spelling.
